sentences.text: ...for the petitioners.
Mr. Arijit Ganguly Mr. Koushik Kundu.
...for the State.
Mr. Kamalesh Jha Ms. Srabani Biswas.
...for the opposite party no.2.
Report submitted by Mr. Koushik Kundu, learned advocate appearing for the State be kept with the record.
The report is enclosed along with the statement and the declaration of one Isha Dey.

The statement,
declaration and the report reflect that the lady, who initiated the proceeding being Watgunge Police Station Case No.12 of 2020 dated 24.11.2020 under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, is not interested to pursue the criminal case as there has been an amicable settlement.

Having considered that the genesis of the case, is on the basis of a matrimonial discord, I am of the opinion that the parties having settled their disputes will not enure any further benefit for the criminal prosecution to continue.

Accordingly, all further proceedings out of Watgunge Police Station Case No.12 of 2020 dated 24.11.2020 under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code including the charge-sheet filed therein pending before the learned CJM, Alipore is hereby quashed.
